title: Method statement requirements, Building B project

requirements.title: Installation window and site supervisor
requirements.text: The method statement states the installation window as a date range and names the site supervisor.

requirements.title: Hold-point inspections
requirements.text: Each hold-point inspection names the inspecting role and the acceptance criteria, and work does not continue until the inspection is signed off.

requirements.title: Recovery actions and owner
requirements.text: If installation fails, the method statement defines specific recovery actions and names the role responsible for them.

requirements.title: Named responsibilities
requirements.text: The method statement names the role responsible for lifting, for electrical isolation, and for inspection sign-off.
